What we do

Home repairs, remodeling & improvements.

From larger renovations to the repairs that keep a home in shape, Hartville Home Maintenance handles a wide range of residential projects.

⌂

Kitchens, Bathrooms & Basements

Kitchen remodeling and refreshes, bathroom and shower projects, basement finishing, drywall, painting, tile, and interior renovations.

▣

Carpentry, Doors & Trim

Interior and exterior doors, windows, trim, molding, framing, rot repair, hardware, weather sealing, and custom carpentry.

◇

Flooring & Interior Finishes

LVP, laminate, hardwood and tile flooring, stairs, backsplashes, countertops, painting, staining, and finish work.

⚙

Home Repairs & Maintenance

General handyman repairs, appliance installation, minor plumbing and electrical work, lighting, drywall repairs, dryer vents, and home safety improvements.

◒

Decks, Porches & Exterior

Decks, porches, railings, fences, siding repairs, gutters, exterior trim, power washing, and seasonal property maintenance.
